title: Loss of reactor cooling
goal: Show the quantified failure logic for redundant cooling pumps and their electrical supply.

rubric.must: The top rectangle visibly states loss of reactor/process cooling.
Two cooling-pump basic events visibly meet at an AND gate for both-pumps failure.
The pump-house flood basic event is visibly repeated beneath both the pump-train and power-supply branches.
Normal bus and standby diesel-generator failures visibly combine before the power-supply branch.
Every basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
A computed cut-set or probability summary is visible without obscuring the tree.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all six rules, while image 2 omits the required repeated pump-house flood event and uses generic power-supply labels.
